WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS sme_lam_diff,
    (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS lam_kam_diff,
    (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) AS kam_sme_diff

WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) as total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
        AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
lowest_consumption_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        CustomerID,
        total_consumption,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC) as rn
    FROM segment_consumption
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AVG(total_consumption) as avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_consumption_customers
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_difference

FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN yearmonth y2012 ON t.CustomerID = y2012.CustomerID 
    AND y2012.Date LIKE '2012%'
JOIN yearmonth y2013 ON t.CustomerID = y2013.CustomerID 
    AND y2013.Date LIKE '2013%'

    AND t.Price = 634.8

WITH customer_transaction AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Amount = 634.8
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT 
        yt.CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN yt.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN yt.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN yt.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN yt.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth yt
    JOIN customer_transaction ct ON yt.CustomerID = ct.CustomerID
    GROUP BY yt.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM consumption_data
WHERE consumption_2012 > 0

WITH customer_with_payment AS (
    SELECT CustomerID 
    FROM transactions_1k 
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customer_with_payment)
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM consumption_data
WHERE consumption_2012 > 0

WITH customer_with_payment AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customer_with_payment cwp ON ym.CustomerID = cwp.CustomerID
    WHERE SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN consumption_2012 > 0 THEN (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM consumption_data

    AVG(CAST(REPLACE(ps.duration, ':', '') AS REAL)) AS avg_duration

JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)
AND res.raceId = (
    SELECT MIN(raceId) 
    FROM results 
    WHERE driverId = (
        SELECT driverId 
        FROM drivers 
        WHERE dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)
    )
)
LIMIT 1
preview: 1 rows: Lance, Stroll, Canadian, Australian Grand Prix

    c.colour,
    COUNT(s.id) as count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(s.id) DESC) as rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id

WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
GROUP BY c.colour
ORDER BY COUNT(s.id) DESC

    l.format,
    COUNT(*) as banned_count,
    GROUP_CONCAT(c.name) as card_names
FROM legalities l
JOIN cards c ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
GROUP BY l.format
ORDER BY banned_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH banned_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        l.format,
        COUNT(*) as banned_count
    FROM legalities l
    WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY l.format
),
max_banned AS (
    SELECT MAX(banned_count) as max_count
    FROM banned_counts
)
SELECT 
    bc.format,
    c.name
FROM banned_counts bc
JOIN max_banned mb ON bc.banned_count = mb.max_count
JOIN legalities l ON bc.format = l.format
JOIN cards c ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'

FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
    AND a.element = 'o'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS molecule_oxygen_counts

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m

    SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN carcinogenic_molecules cm ON a.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'f'
),
carcinogenic_without_fluorine AS (
    SELECT cm.molecule_id
    FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
    LEFT JOIN molecules_with_fluorine mf ON cm.molecule_id = mf.molecule_id
    WHERE mf.molecule_id IS NULL
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
    AND b.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT a2.molecule_id
        FROM atom a2
        WHERE a2.element = 'p' OR a2.element = 'br'
    )
)

SELECT 
    s."CharterNum",
    AVG(ss."AvgScrWrite") AS average_writing_score,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ss."AvgScrWrite") DESC) AS rank
FROM 
    "schools" s
JOIN 
    "satscores" ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE 
    ss."AvgScrWrite" > 499
    AND s."CharterNum" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    s."CharterNum"
ORDER BY 
    average_writing_score DESC

    SELECT AVG("Enrollment (K-12)" - "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_difference
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded'

    SELECT

    JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"

    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM schools s2
    JOIN satscores ss2 ON s2."CDSCode" = ss2."cds"
    WHERE s2."County" = s."County"
    AND ss2."AvgScrRead" >= ss."AvgScrRead"

SELECT sname
FROM (
    SELECT satscores.sname,
           satscores.cname,
           AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) as avg_reading_score,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY satscores.cname ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC) as rank
    FROM satscores
    JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE schools.Virtual = 'F'
    GROUP BY satscores.sname, satscores.cname
)
WHERE rank <= 5
ORDER BY cname, avg_reading_score DESC

WITH first_loan_client AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    LIMIT 1
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t1 
         JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t1.account_id IN (
             SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = flc.client_id
         )
         WHERE t1.date = '1993-03-22' 
         ORDER BY t1.trans_id 
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_start,
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t2 
         JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t2.account_id IN (
             SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = flc.client_id
         )
         WHERE t2.date = '1998-12-27' 
         ORDER BY t2.trans_id DESC 
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_end
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN balance_start IS NOT NULL AND balance_end IS NOT NULL AND balance_start != 0
        THEN ((balance_end - balance_start) * 100.0 / balance_start)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS increase_rate
FROM balances
